en.d: A module is a course your coaches complete — made of units, which are made of lessons. Manage them all under Club Settings → Modules.
Click "Create Module". Your work is saved as a draft automatically while you build.
Give it a clear title and a short description. You can credit a coach, and keep the status "Unpublished" until it's ready.
Upload a cover image (SVG, PNG or JPG), optionally award a certificate, and set CPD points — by default they total up automatically from each unit.
In the Units section, click "Create Unit" to open the unit builder.

Give the unit its own CPD points and estimated duration. Optionally add a time limit, or enable "Free navigation" so coaches can move between lessons in any order — otherwise they complete them in sequence.

en.t: Build lessons from six content types
en.d: Add lessons, then fill each one with items: Question, Video, Article, PDF, External Video or SCORM. A typical lesson is a video followed by a question.

en.t: Set the pass mark and save
en.d: Use "Percentage To Pass" to set how much of the unit a coach must complete, then click "Create Unit". You can Preview it first, exactly as a coach would see it.

en.doneT: Your content is ready to publish!
en.doneD: Set the module's status to "Published" when you're happy. To make it visible to coaches, add it to a Content Rail and place that rail on your page in Page Builder — that's what builds their home screen.
en.lead: For club admins. Create your own modules — units, lessons, videos, questions, even SCORM — and award CPD for completing them.
